comparison.position: BuggyMLE先审核可运行、指标稳定且对代码变化敏感的ML仓库，再让Injector注入不同规模的错误。Oracle通过逐个恢复变动找最小恢复集合，再把每个改动单独应用到干净仓库，筛出确有独立指标影响的错误。Solver必须在多文件仓库里真实修复；评价同时检查执行、指标恢复和逐错误语义修复，不能把补偿性调参当修好了全部bug。
comparison.tradeoff: MLE-STAR用检索、真实消融与validation结果定位并改进模型代码；BuggyMLE用有Oracle归因的注入错误构建难度阶梯，CCI是评测/课程设计尺度。前者选改进方案，后者塑造训练与评测任务；不能把后者的结构分数当成前者的真实验证收益。

analysis.title: BuggyMLE：用代码复杂度分层，而不是把指标恢复当完整修复
analysis.body: CCI在八个参考benchmark上，先取十项结构特征的任务中位数，做log1p和特征z-score，再对repo、dependency、patch三组求均值，并把组分数按参考方差缩放。固定logistic系数的负加权和构成raw CCI，再用参考最小/最大值定标。新任务不能重新拟合或裁剪回[0,1]。Figure10的repo系数为+0.64，dependency为-0.34，patch为-0.99；repo项是给定其他项的条件调整，不支持“仓库越大必然越难”。负控保留正repo系数、组方差缩放和参考区间外结果；验证median不是mean，未给截距时不捏造预测成功率。拒绝NaN、零尺度和退化边界。Table4把total_lines_delta写成净变化，若值≤-1会使log1p无定义，接口明确拒绝，既不取绝对值，也不补造作者未说明的变换。

question.question: CCI和MLE-STAR的消融分数能互换吗？
question.answer: 不能。CCI预测结构困难度，MLE-STAR用执行和validation消融选择值得改的代码块；结构困难不等于模型效果差。
question.example: 教学例：跨文件修复很难，并不说明该模型validation AUC低。

update.summary: 本地仅实现给定十项特征的benchmark中位数、固定校准投影和可选的稳定logistic读数。没有AST/依赖图抽取、Injector、Oracle、LLM solver、校准拟合或模型训练。完整μ/σ、组尺度、截距与参考边界未在原文公开成可直接加载文件，因此API强制调用方显式提供Calibration；诊断用合成校准，不能称为复算了作者八benchmark CCI。Patch特征属于构建/评测端，不能把隐藏修复补丁或其困难标签传给被测Agent。 完整实验高成本不复现。

comparison.position: BuggyMLE audits runnable ML repositories with stable, responsive metrics, then uses an Injector to create controlled mutations. An Oracle first finds a minimal reversion set and then applies each mutation separately to the clean repository to identify individually impactful bugs. Solvers repair multi-file repositories. Execution, metric recovery and per-bug semantic repair are checked separately; compensating through tuning is not equivalent to repairing every bug.
comparison.tradeoff: MLE-STAR uses retrieval, actual ablations and validation results to improve model code. BuggyMLE builds difficulty tiers from oracle-attributed injected bugs; CCI is a curation/curriculum scale. Selecting an improved solution differs from shaping evaluation/training tasks, and a structural score is not a validation improvement.

analysis.title: BuggyMLE: Scaling Machine Learning Engineering Difficulty with Bug Injection
analysis.body: CCI uses task-level median structural features on eight reference benchmarks, applies log1p and feature z-scores, averages within repository, dependency and patch groups, then rescales group scores by reference variance. The negative coefficient-weighted sum is raw CCI, followed by fixed reference min-max scaling. A new task must not refit or clip the scale. Figure10 gives coefficients +0.64, -0.34 and -0.99; the positive repository term is a conditional adjustment, not a claim that larger repositories are always harder. Controls preserve the positive repository coefficient, group variance scaling and out-of-reference outputs, check median rather than mean, and return no predicted success without an intercept. NaNs, zero scales and degenerate bounds fail. Table4 calls total_lines_delta net line change; values≤-1 make log1p undefined and are rejected, not silently absolutized or replaced with an undocumented transform.

question.question: Can CCI replace MLE-STAR's ablation score?
question.answer: No. CCI models structural difficulty; MLE-STAR uses execution and validation ablations to choose code changes. Structural difficulty is not model quality.
question.example: Teaching example: a difficult cross-file repair does not imply low validation AUC.

english.update: The local slice implements medians of supplied ten-feature rows, fixed-calibration projection and an optional numerically stable logistic readout. It does not extract ASTs/dependency graphs, run an Injector/Oracle/solver, fit calibration or train models. Complete means, scales, intercept and reference bounds are not released as a loadable artifact, so Calibration is an explicit required input. Diagnostics use synthetic calibration and do not reproduce the author's eight-benchmark CCI. Patch features belong to curation/evaluation; hidden repair patches or their difficulty labels must not be exposed to the evaluated agent. Full experiments not reproduced.

comparison.position: System One决策模型能快速选动作，但局部选择正确不保证长任务完成。LoopRoute默认把控制权交给冻结Jev；只有同一公开状态下的同一动作已经执行两次，才拦截第三次提案，让LLM按实际环境反馈接管最多两步，然后无额外恢复测试地交回Jev。后续再次卡住可再次接管。
comparison.tradeoff: Selective Reasoning依据共享读出、benefit gate和答案分布确定性，决定何时生成/读取/停止推理；LoopRoute依据真实环境状态-动作复现，决定是否把控制权短暂交给另一policy。前者的高certainty不代表环境已进展，后者的未重复也不保证动作正确。

analysis.title: LoopRoute：在重复执行前拦截，让LLM只接管两步
analysis.body: 状态key不含不断增长的history或step。ALFWorld用已确认事实和排序后的可行动作；MapReader用当前动作回应、房间描述和inventory；TextWorld用房间、inventory和候选ID到命令映射。ALFWorld只累计决策模型执行，新事实或接管结束会清空；另外两者累计两种policy的执行并保持到episode结束。被拦截提案既不占环境步，也不更新计数。负控区分相同动作但不同状态、未执行提案和真实执行；拒绝未提交transition就再次route，防止重试被当执行。测试ALFWorld不计LLM动作、接管结束清空，以及MapReader/TextWorld计两种动作且不清空。终止立即结束接管；共享key拒绝history/step/gold附加字段。

question.question: LoopRoute和Selective Reasoning都省推理，证据一样吗？
question.answer: 不一样。一个看环境中的重复执行，另一个看冻结读出与推理收益/确定性；重复不是低置信度，高置信度也不等于任务有进展。
question.example: 教学例：模型非常确信地反复开一个锁住的门，仍应触发循环路由。

update.summary: 本地执行公开状态key、pending decision/实际执行分离、第三次提案拦截、准确两步接管及各benchmark计数规则。只接受显式公开字段，不接收gold、奖励或成功标签；new_information由可信外部ALFWorld适配器提供，本地不假装语义核实事实。没有Jev/LLM backend、benchmark环境或实际API请求；控制轨迹只证明路由规则，不证明任务成功率。 完整实验高成本不复现。

comparison.position: Fast System One action selection does not guarantee long-task completion. LoopRoute normally gives control to frozen Jev. After the same action has executed twice under the same public state, it intercepts the next proposal and lets an LLM take at most two feedback-driven actions. Control then returns without a separate recovery test; later loops can trigger another takeover.
comparison.tradeoff: Selective Reasoning uses shared readout, a benefit gate and answer-distribution certainty to start, read and stop reasoning. LoopRoute uses recurrence of executed public state/action pairs to hand control briefly to another policy. High certainty is not environment progress, and absence of recurrence is not action correctness.

analysis.title: Stop Going in Circles:Loop-Triggered Routing for System 1 Decision Agents
analysis.body: Keys exclude growing history and step counters. ALFWorld uses confirmed facts and sorted admissible actions; MapReader uses the action response, room description and inventory; TextWorld uses room, inventory and the candidate-ID/command map. ALFWorld counts only decision-policy executions and clears on new information or takeover completion. The other adapters count both policies and retain counts throughout the episode. Intercepted proposals consume no environment step and update no count. Controls distinguish the same action in different states, proposals and executions. Routing again before recording a transition fails, preventing retries from counting as execution. Tests cover ALFWorld excluding LLM actions and clearing at handoff, versus both-policy persistent counters elsewhere. Termination immediately ends takeover; public-key schemas reject added history/step/gold fields.

question.question: Does it use the same evidence as Selective Reasoning?
question.answer: No. LoopRoute observes recurring executions; Selective Reasoning uses frozen readout and benefit/certainty. Recurrence is not uncertainty, and certainty is not progress.
question.example: Teaching example: confidently reopening a locked door can still trigger recurrence routing.

english.update: The local kernel executes public-state keys, separate pending decisions and actual executions, third-proposal interception, exact two-action takeovers and benchmark-specific counters. It takes declared public fields, not gold/reward/success labels. A trusted external ALFWorld adapter supplies new_information; semantic fact verification is not implemented. There is no Jev/LLM backend, benchmark environment or API request. Controlled traces validate routing rules, not task success. Full experiments not reproduced.

comparison.position: GrepMem把有限工作上下文和完整历史分开：压缩时只把活跃上下文换成系统提示、任务与摘要，原始消息、工具调用/输出和摘要仍追加到纯文本日志。第一次压缩之后才开放grep_history，让模型按需用大小写不敏感正则取回遗漏细节。不需要embedding、索引或知识抽取，但“lossless”只指原日志保留，不代表模型每次都能找对或答对。
comparison.tradeoff: MemGPT以分层内存、page-out/page-in与模型工具调用管理归档；GrepMem不预先抽取归档结构，保留原始轨迹并做词法搜索。两者都可压缩工作上下文，但GrepMem没有减少原始日志占盘；模型是否会选对检索词仍需训练与真实任务评价，本地固定key的旧MemGPT诊断也不能作能力对照。

analysis.title: GrepMem：压缩工作上下文，但保留可grep的原始历史
analysis.body: grep按原始记录头与行号返回最早匹配，默认10条、最多30条，offset跳过匹配行而非记录；前后context默认1行、最多3行。旧grep结果仍留在原日志，但搜索跳过它们以免递归重复。单次输出上限6K字符，围绕匹配裁到300字符并在完整match边界停止，返回继续offset；非法正则或超过10秒都返回错误。控制测试验证摘要可遗漏原始细节而日志仍保留、只计原始匹配而不递归grep输出、大小写无关、连续offset不漏页；长行与多匹配验证6K上限，灾难性回溯正则会终止worker，随后正常查询仍可用。论文的模型turn预算、自动token估计与forced-answer调用不在这个存储工具组件内，不捏造自动压缩策略或训练效果。

question.question: 它和MemGPT的记忆结构有什么不同？
question.answer: MemGPT分层管理与换入换出，GrepMem保留原始文本、按正则取回而不建语义索引；两者都不能仅凭存储单测宣称模型会正确回忆。
question.example: 教学例：grep订单编号不要求先把订单提炼成一条结构化记忆。

update.summary: 本地实现append-only记录、显式摘要压缩、第一次压缩后的grep准入、正则/分页/上下文/原行号、跳过旧grep输出与字符上限。正则在隔离子进程内运行并用硬timeout终止，仅接收输入文本而不打开路径。摘要由调用方明确提供；没有LLM摘要器、GRPO、问题回答或真实历史接入。只对合成公开观察做控制测试，不读取本机Codex会话，也不把字符串检索当Agent能力。 完整实验高成本不复现。

comparison.position: GrepMem separates bounded working context from complete history. Compaction replaces active context with the system prompt, task and summary, while original messages, tool calls/results and summaries remain in an append-only text log. Only after first compaction can the policy use case-insensitive grep_history to recover omitted details. No embeddings, index or extraction are required. Lossless describes log retention, not guaranteed retrieval or answers.
comparison.tradeoff: MemGPT manages layered memory and archival paging through model tool calls. GrepMem avoids a pre-extracted archive and lexically searches raw trajectories. Both can compact active context, but GrepMem does not reduce raw-log storage. Selecting useful search terms still needs training and real task evaluation; the older local fixed-key MemGPT diagnostic is not a capability baseline.

analysis.title: Forget Freely, Grep Later: Lossless, Index-Free Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
analysis.body: Search returns oldest matches under original record headers and line numbers:10 by default, at most30, with an offset over matching lines rather than records and up to three context lines. Prior grep outputs remain logged but are skipped by searches to avoid recursive duplication. Responses cap at6K characters, clip lines around matches to300 characters, stop at whole matches and return a continuation offset. Invalid regexes and searches exceeding ten seconds return errors. Controls check omitted summary details remain in the log, grep outputs do not duplicate original matches, case-insensitive search and continuation offsets work, and long lines/many hits respect6K. Catastrophic regex backtracking terminates only the worker and a later normal query still works. Model-turn budgets, token estimation and forced-answer calls are outside this storage/tool slice; no automatic compression policy or training gain is fabricated.

question.question: How does its memory differ from MemGPT?
question.answer: MemGPT manages layers and paging; GrepMem preserves raw text and retrieves through regex without a semantic index. Neither storage unit test proves model recall.
question.example: Teaching example: grepping an order ID needs no prior extraction into a structured memory entry.

english.update: The local substrate implements append-only records, explicit-summary compaction, post-compaction grep admission, regex/pagination/context/original line numbers, recursive-output exclusion and character limits. Regexes run in a separate worker with a hard timeout over supplied text, never paths. Summaries are explicit caller inputs. There is no LLM summarizer, GRPO, question answering or real-history integration. Tests use synthetic public observations and never read local Codex sessions; string retrieval is not agent capability. Full experiments not reproduced.
